actions.desc: create page /about
actions.mutation: mutation C($p: PageCreateInput!) { pageCreate(page: $p) { page { id } userErrors { field message } } }

p.title: About
p.body:
One table that seats one person on a weekday and twelve at a family dinner. Every piece in this collection extends, stacks or folds so a small home can host like a big one.

This is an interview sandbox store built to demonstrate multi-market Shopify operations. It is not an official Transformer Table store.

actions.desc: create page /how-it-transforms
actions.mutation: mutation C($p: PageCreateInput!) { pageCreate(page: $p) { page { id } userErrors { field message } } }

p.title: How It Transforms
p.body:
Telescopic steel tracks run under the tabletop. Pull the ends apart, drop in the stored leaves, and the table grows in 30 cm steps. No tools, no loose parts.

  1. Pull both ends outward until the track clicks.
  2. Lift a leaf from the storage slot and set it on the pins.
  3. Push the ends together to lock.

actions.desc: create page /delivery-and-returns
actions.mutation: mutation C($p: PageCreateInput!) { pageCreate(page: $p) { page { id } userErrors { field message } } }

p.title: Delivery & Returns
p.body:
Delivery dates shown on each product come from our 3PL stock per country and update when a container moves. The date you see at checkout is saved on your order.

  • In stock locally: 3–5 business days.
  • Low stock: 5–8 business days.
  • Pre-order: the batch window shown on the product.

Returns: 30 days in the UK and Australia; the statutory 14-day withdrawal right applies in the EU. Draft text, pending legal review per market.

actions.desc: create page /warranty
actions.mutation: mutation C($p: PageCreateInput!) { pageCreate(page: $p) { page { id } userErrors { field message } } }

p.title: Warranty
p.body: 10 years on frames and tracks for tables, benches and storage; 5 years on chairs, stools and outdoor pieces. Consumer law in your country applies in addition to this warranty. Draft text, pending legal review.

actions.desc: create page /care-guide
actions.mutation: mutation C($p: PageCreateInput!) { pageCreate(page: $p) { page { id } userErrors { field message } } }

p.title: Care Guide
p.body: Wipe with a damp cloth, dry straight away, and re-oil twice a year with the Hardwood Care Kit. Keep the tracks free of crumbs and use the dry lubricant once a year.

actions.desc: create page /faq
actions.mutation: mutation C($p: PageCreateInput!) { pageCreate(page: $p) { page { id } userErrors { field message } } }

p.title: FAQ
p.body:
How long does delivery take?

The window on the product page is calculated from the stock in your country's warehouse.

Are prices shown with tax?

Yes in the UK, EU, Australia and the GCC: the price you see includes local VAT or GST.

Can I order a finish that is out of stock?

Some finishes are open for pre-order. The batch window is shown before you pay and saved on your order.

actions.desc: publish article 'How to choose an expandable dining table for a small flat'
actions.mutation: mutation A($a: ArticleCreateInput!) { articleCreate(article: $a) { article { id } userErrors { field message } } }

a.title: How to choose an expandable dining table for a small flat
a.body:
Measure the room at its everyday size, not the dinner-party size. A table that is 46 cm deep when closed leaves a walkway in most hallways; one that opens to 3 m needs a clear run along one wall.

Check the mechanism: telescopic tracks keep the leaves aligned; loose leaves need storage space.

actions.desc: publish article 'Hosting twelve in 40 square metres: a planning checklist'
actions.mutation: mutation A($a: ArticleCreateInput!) { articleCreate(article: $a) { article { id } userErrors { field message } } }

a.title: Hosting twelve in 40 square metres: a planning checklist
a.body:
Plan seating first: a bench seats more people per metre than chairs. Stackable chairs live in a corner until needed.

Extend the table the day before and check the floor protectors are on every leg.

a.title: Caring for oiled hardwood through the seasons
a.body: Central heating dries wood in winter. Re-oil in autumn and spring, keep the table away from radiators, and wipe spills straight away.

a.body: Oak is light and hides scratches. Hickory has a strong grain. Walnut is darker and shows dust. Sequoia is a limited batch with a warm red tone. Order the sample kit to see them in your light.

a.body: When a finish is between containers, you can still order it. The window shown is the batch arrival plus local delivery. If a container moves, we update the window on the product and tell customers whose dates changed.
